jobs_results.title: Application Developer
jobs_results.description:
At Uniter, we are happy to open a new exciting role!

The Software Developer will lead the design, development, and implementation of software solutions, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to meet project requirements and deliver exceptional results. They will demonstrate proficiency in programming languages and development frameworks, while also staying updated on emerging technologies and industry trends. The role requires a strong focus on problem-solving, adaptability, and collaboration, as well as a commitment to producing clean, efficient code and meeting project deadlines.

This key role reports directly to the Managing Director of Operations, ALS Uniter Group

Role and Responsibilities

· Work closely with the development team to understand project requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

· Utilize modern programming technologies and databases to design and develop web applications that meet project requirements and industry standards.

·... Perform thorough testing and debugging of applications to ensure functionality, security, and optimal performance.

· Continuously maintain and improve existing applications as needed to meet evolving business needs and technological advancements.

· Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends to enhance development processes and improve the quality of the final product.

· Develop and implement system architectures based on microservices principles to enhance scalability, modularity, and system efficiency.

· Integrate applications using microservices to improve system scalability, modularity, and efficiency.

· Demonstrate proficiency in Java programming and the use of frameworks such as Spring Boot or MicroProfile.

· Integrate web applications with external systems and third-party APIs to achieve efficient interoperability and a seamless user experience.

Experience and Education

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

· Proven experience as a Software Developer or Software Engineer.

· Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript.

· Experience with software development methodologies such as Agile or Scrum.

· Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development tools.

· Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

· Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

Technical competences and skills

· Proficiency in English and the applicable local language(s).

· Strong knowledge of programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and frameworks like Spring Boot, React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.

· Experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g., SQL, MongoDB) for efficient data storage and retrieval.

· Proficiency in designing and implementing microservices architectures to enhance system scalability and efficiency.

· Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts clearly and

· Results-driven with the ability to efficiently manage multiple tasks and prioritize work to meet project deadlines and goals.

Core competences

· Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and develop innovative solutions.

· Adaptability: Capacity to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to changing project requirements and priorities.

· Collaboration: Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and disciplines.

· Attention to Detail: Commitment to producing high-quality code and delivering software solutions that meet or exceed client expectations.

· Time Management: Effective prioritization and time management skills to meet project deadlines and deliverables.

· Continuous Learning: Eagerness to stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to enhance technical skills and expertise.

· Creativity: Ability to think creatively and propose innovative approaches to software design and development challenges

· Critical Thinking: Capacity to evaluate different options and make informed decisions based on technical feasibility, project requirements, and business objectives.

· Communication Skills: Clear and concise communication skills, both verbal and written, to convey technical concepts and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders.

· Quality Assurance: Commitment to writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code, as well as conducting thorough testing to ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of software applications

jobs_results.title: Mid iOS Developer
jobs_results.description:
One of the companies we work with is looking for a Mid iOS Developer to join the team.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for a talented and passionate Mid iOS Developer to join our mobile development team. You’ll be leading our efforts to build amazing UI/UX on our apps, including the most popular Motivation app - with over 20 million users.

Our offer:
• 🧠 Work on products that matter: 2 of our apps are among the most downloaded apps in the Mental Health space, with a 4.9 rating and over 500k reviews each.
• 📈 We’re bootstrapped and profitable, and we believe we can continue growing sustainably without pressure from outside investors or an exit strategy.
• ⌛We are a remote team and strive for an ideal work-life balance: work asynchronously as much as possible and minimize meetings to set your schedule with flexible hours.
• 🐒 Enjoy extra holidays → 4 additional company-wide days off (one per quarter).
• 🏖️ Extended vacations after your 1st year -up to 5 additional days... plus the possibility to travel and work from anywhere.
• 💻 Choose your ideal remote work setup with an equipment allowance.
• 💳 Manage your compensation options (via Cobee) → food and daycare expenses, medical insurance.
• 😌 Mental healthcare support.
• 🍸 Enjoy outings, paid for by the company.
• 🪪 Manage licenses for Work-Related Software → budget to have the necessary software to excel in your role.
• 🏛️ Boost your English skills → free lessons with a native speaker.
• Salary range starting at 50.000€.

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate closely with Designers, Product Managers, and Backend Developers to ensure seamless integration of UI components and functionality.
• Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve our core apps.
• Write high quality, high-performing and well-tested code.
• Turn design requirements and prototypes into working features.
• Work and play with many different libraries and tools (Widgets, WatchOS, Notification Center, etc).

Requirements:
• Positive attitude, a real passion for apps, genuine care of our users, and strong ownership of the product.
• At least 4+ years of writing Swift code.
• Experience working with SwiftUI.
• Passion for creating delightful user interfaces, with attention to detail.
• Design and develop innovative, user-friendly, and visually stunning iOS applications creating delightful User Interfaces.
• Employ creative problem-solving skills to overcome UI challenges and provide elegant solutions that enhance the UX.
• Expertise in building visually appealing UIs, ability to share your experience with other members of the development team.
• Strong problem-solving skills and experience in troubleshooting bugs and performance issues in iOS applications.
• Ability to work well with others by listening, giving constructive feedback and communicating clearly.
• Ability to hack solutions when necessary, making the right trade-offs in dealing with conflicting priorities.
• Passion for mental health, positive psychology and self-improvement.

Nice to haves:
• Experience managing growth initiatives like A/B testing and rapid prototyping.
• Strong grasp of iOS Apple development tools (e.g. Organizer, LLDB, and Instruments) and different SDKs.
• Experience working in a high-growth startup.

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Java/Spring para Arquitecturas de Microservicios...
jobs_results.description:
La compañía

Se trata de una empresa española fundada en el año 2000 que trabaja activamente con empresas de todo el mundo, ayudándoles en la transformación digital con una propuesta de valor completa, incluyendo el desarrollo y despliegue de soluciones estructurales innovadoras.

El contrato será como empleado interno e indefinido.

Descripción del puesto

Buscamos un Desarrollador Senior Java/Spring que forme parte de un equipo en continuo crecimiento y con ganas de afrontar nuevos retos y crecer profesionalmente.

Experiencia laboral

Larga experiencia en desarrollo con Java y Spring

Lugar de trabajo

100% Remoto, obligatoria residencia en España y permiso de trabajo ya existente

Salario

En función de la experiencia.

Competencias requeridas (experiencia laboral demostrable)
• Sólidos conocimientos de JAVA
• Profundos conocimientos de las mejores prácticas de desarrollo de software, patrones de diseño y principios de código limpio
• Conocimiento de API RESTful
• Experiencia... práctica con bases de datos relacionales y no-SQL
• Conocimiento del control de versiones mediante GIT
• Capacidad para adaptarse a nuevas tecnologías y entornos según las necesidades del proyecto

Conocimientos valorables
• Experiencia con Spring Framework
• Experiencia con programación reactiva y frameworks como Project Reactor
• Comprensión de la arquitectura de microservicios
• Conocimiento de sistemas de intercambio de mensajes como RabbitMQ o Kafka
• Experiencia con metodologías de pruebas de software
• Familiaridad con herramientas de contenedores y orquestación como Docker y Kubernetes

Idiomas
• Español: nativo o fluido
• Inglés: capacidad de comunicación mínimo B1, deseable B2

Interesad@s aplicad aquí o enviad CV a java@montarelo.com indicando en el título "Desarrollador Java"

jobs_results.title: Senior PHP Developer - Full Stack
jobs_results.description:
SGF Global is a global leader with over 30 years’ experience providing recruitment solutions.

Seleccionamos un/a desarrollador PHP Senior para uno de nuestros clientes, una empresa fundada en 2008 para el desarrollo y la comercialización de soluciones técnicas de vanguardia de productos en el sector salud.

Nace de una empresa anterior de desarrollo de software para terceros y la unión de un grupo

inversor del sector dental.

Con el objetivo muy claro de convertirnos en una empresa de referencia tecnológica en el

sector salud.

Hace 12 años fuimos la primera empresa en España en ofrecer una solución 100% cloud para

la gestión de clínicas dentales.

Actualmente utilizada en más de 1500 clínicas en toda España.

Es el único software 100% cloud especializado en clínicas universitarias, utilizado por los

departamentos de odontología de universidades como La Salle, Alfonso X el Sabio, Rey Juan

Carlos, Europea de Madrid, Católica de Valencia, San Pablo CEU,

Está desarrollada en... SQLServer, C#,.NET, AngularJS, ...

Han lanzado al mercado una plataforma 100% mobile first, desarrollada en PHP, con Amazon AWS, utilizando el framework Laravel, MariaDB, Material Design, … y utilizando soluciones que

apliquen IA, a nivel de soporte de para nuestros clientes como en soluciones para las clínicas.

Formarás parte del principal departamento de la empresa.

Actualmente son en total 30 personas.

Aunque ofrecemos un puesto 100% teletrabajo, la oficina principal se encuentra en el corazón

de Guadalajara, con facilidad para el aparcamiento gratuito.

Para ponerte en situación con el proyecto, durante los primeros meses combinarás el trabajo presencial con el teletrabajo, teniendo que venir a la oficina al menos 2 días a la semana.

Queremos profesionales que se ilusionen con nuestro proyecto, se queden con nosotros y

evolucionen profesionalmente.

Qué ofrecemos:
• Un puesto indefinido con un periodo de prueba de dos meses.
• En un proyecto que te supondrá un reto profesional
• En una empresa en la que trabajarás muy a gusto, con los medios técnicos necesarios para desarrollar correctamente tu trabajo.
• Que te permita evolucionar y estar al tanto de las nuevas tecnologías.
• Una remuneración acorde a tu experiencia y con posibilidad de mejorar en función de tu implicación y evolución en la empresa.
• Jornada continua de mañana.
• Plan de desarrollo profesional.
• Formación y renovación en las últimas tecnologías.
• Muy buen ambiente de trabajo.
• 100% teletrabajo
• Flexibilidad horaria y conciliación familiar.

Skills necesarias:

● Buena capacidad de análisis funcional y técnico

● Nivel muy alto en desarrollo PHP y experiencia con el framework Laravel

● Nivel alto en jQuery y “VanillaJS”

● Nivel alto en diseño de bases de datos

● Dominio de patrones de diseño: SOLID y TDD

● Metodología de trabajo SCRUM

● Conocimiento alto de inglés escrito

● Actitud proactiva y comunicativa

● Experiencia mínima de 4 años con estas tecnologías:

○ PHP

○ Laravel

○ Docker

○ MySQL

Skills valoradas:

● Desarrollo web en C# .NET

● Conocimientos avanzados UX

● Conocimientos avanzados en AWS

● Conocimientos en inteligencia artificial

● Conocimientos en seguridad informática

● Desarrollo JAVA

● Desarrollo en NET Core

● Desarrollo en Python

Si crees que este proyecto puede encajar contigo aplica a la oferta y nos pondremos en contacto contigo

• Experiencia con bases de datos SQL.

Si te gusta la idea, ¡no dudes en postularte! Aunque no cumplas con todos los requisitos, tu perfil puede ser de interés para futuras oportunidades

jobs_results.title: Software Developer (FullStack), DSPro
jobs_results.description:
The creative and dynamic team of Vorwerk‘s Direct Selling Products project is involved in the development and maintenance of the application DSPro, which is the current commission's engine supporting the calculation of the bonuses and payments, as a reward for the main business activity for the salesforce at Vorwerk. Simultaneously we are preparing the technical bases for the design of the new commissions' engine that will be the evolution of DSPro as a modern, scalable, and high-performance platform. We are prepared to combine Vorwerk’s long-standing, high-quality engineering experience with agile methodologies, leading-edge technologies, and laser-sharp focus on our customer satisfaction, to provide a commission engine as a key technological platform in the business model of the company.

We are looking for a creative, passionate, results-oriented, ambitious, and self-driven Software Developer who wants to play a challenging role in the development of DSPro and our digital products... to be located in our Nearshore Development Center in Madrid, Spain.

Tech Skills
• Degree in Science Computer, comparable qualifications, or equivalent coding working experience.
• Min 3+ years of relevant experience in Java-based programming.
• Min 3+ years of relevant experience in JavaScript/HTML/CSS
• Min 3 + years of relevant experience in Angular/React/Vue
• Demonstrable and significant experience as a Java Developer or similar role, designing and implementing applications with Java and its ecosystem. Experience with other languages is a major plus.
• In-depth knowledge of popular Java frameworks like Spring IoC, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Batch, Spring Data, and AKKA.
• Demonstrable working experience in coding the access to the databases with the most common data models in the market (MySQL/Oracel/PostgreSQL).
• Experience in the development of APIs using RESTfull style, including the best practices to define resources and the integration aspect related to exposing business operations as an API, like security, interoperability, etc.
• Experience with Object-Oriented Design (OOD), including good control and applying the GoF design patterns.
• Demonstrable experience in designing and implementing applications on Angular versions 10 or superior. Including the integration with RESTfull web services.
• Working experience using Git as control version systems and the development process cycle with branches, features, and releases, including SourceTree as tools to work with Git.
• Strong technical documentation skills, not only in the code but in creating technical documents including formal diagrams in languages like UML and PowerPoint presentations.
• Excellent knowledge and demonstrable experience working with Agile methodologies, like Scrum.

MAIN ACTIVITIES
• Collaborate with the team on the design of the new platform, bringing your expertise and new ideas to the team.
• Designing, creating, implementing, and maintaining the functionalities of the DSPro according to the planning and roadmap of the product, ensuring to meet deadlines on time according to the established service level agreement for the DSPro project.
• Interpreting briefs to create high-quality, well-design, and efficient code that fulfills the specifications and the requirements of the business stakeholders of Vorwerk.
• Design and implement the unit tests for the code developed for the DSPro functionalities. Including the collaboration with the QA teams associated with the DSPro project, to serve as a technical reference in the automation of the business test cases.
• As part of the per-to-per revision, review, test, and debug team members’ code.
• Ensuring to meet deadlines on fast-paced deliverables.
• Participate in the technical/product review/planning/refinement process defined by the Agile methodology ceremonies.
• Participating in group meetings and relevant business meetings to discuss any aspect of DSPro as a commission engine.
• Generates and maintains the business and technical documentation of the developments on DSPro using Confluence.
• Log and document the development working activities using the tracking systems, like Jira, Time reporting, etc.
• Assisting other developers with troubleshooting, debugging, and coding exhibiting collaboration as the main pillar of our team.
• Collaborate with the Team Leader on the design of the new platform, bringing your expertise and new ideas to the team
